intervals.label: construction of the experiment at MESA
intervals.locator: arXiv:1802.04759 abstract (the "future P2 facility" at the "upcoming" MESA); components "currently under construction" in the body; MESA page lists P2 among the MESA experimental setups
intervals.note: No source dates the start of P2 construction; February 2018 is the date of the P2 design paper naming the host. The MESA accelerator is itself still under construction, so the experiment has not started data taking.
intervals.quote: This article describes the future P2 parity-violating electron scattering facility at the upcoming MESA accelerator in Mainz.

summary.plain: A solenoid-based spectrometer with Cherenkov detectors, tracking detectors and precision polarimetry that will measure the scattering of polarised electrons from hydrogen.
summary.technical: P2: liquid-hydrogen target, integrating solenoid spectrometer with full azimuthal acceptance and Cherenkov detectors, tracking detectors (micromegas) and precision beam polarimetry (Moller and hydrogen-atom-trap polarimeters).
